## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
The current Ring intergration is not supporting Ring Intercom devices (https://it-it.ring.com/products/intercom), as described here https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/82565.
I've added support for it, introducing new sensors, and button to open door
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2064515/232764912-23f7a565-b509-4ae0-b9dc-7506a0b3cae7.png)

-->

- [ ] Code quality improvements to existing code or addition of tests

## Additional information

  Please be sure to fill out additional details, if applicable.
-->

- This PR fixes or closes issue: fixes #82565
- This PR is related to issue: 
- Link to documentation pull request: https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/pull/27050

- [ ] New or updated dependencies have been added to `requirements_all.txt`.

- [ ] For the updated dependencies - a link to the changelog, or at minimum a diff between library versions is added to the PR description.
- [ ] Untested files have been added to `.coveragerc`.

Hallo Gunter, 
das wird so leider nicht funktionieren, da der HomeKit-Controller  nur die Geräte bereitstellt, die sich im eigentlichem Apple Universum befinden (https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homekit_controller/). Diese Integration holt sich also den Ring Intercom von meiner Homebridge. Die HomeKit Integration ist dafür gedacht Geräte und Entitäten von HomeAssistant auf einer Hombridge zur Verfügung zu stellen also umgekehrter weg wie z.B. von HomeAssistant zu Alexa über NabuCasa (https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homekit/).

Das was es hier nun bräuchte um es direkt auf HassOS zum laufen zu bringen wäre ein Add-On was es leider wohl nicht mehr gibt (https://github.com/hassio-addons/addon-homebridge) :-/

Bei mir läuft die Hombridge in einem gesonderten Container auf meinem Unraid NAS, da dieser auch gleichzeitig mein Datenbankserver, DNS, RverseProxy, MQTT Broker etc. zur Verfügung stellt muss das ohnehin immer laufen. Somit hat mein RPI4 auch nicht ganz soviel Last :-)

This is usually an issue with the HA web UI that can be resolved by forcing a browser refresh of the HA UI.  For reasons I don't fully understand, when devices discovery informaiton is first sent to HA via MQTT, the devices will actually be there, but somehow only partially display in the UI, but a forced refresh is all that is typically needed, as the devices really are discovered.  It feels like it is some kind of race condition between with the first entity of a device is sent and the device is initially created.  I've tried playing with the timing of the MQTT discovery messages, but have never been able to fully eliminate the issue.  I've never seen an actualy case where the forced hard browser refresh didn't work, but it confuses users quite a bit and most don't know to take such action.
